description: This file defines a PHP class, HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Ruby, which implements the XHTML 1.1 Ruby Annotation Module for the HTML Purifier library. It specifies elements related to ruby annotations used for pronunciation or annotations in text, including setup of elements like 'ruby', 'rbc', 'rtc', 'rb', 'rt', and 'rp'.

classes.name: HTMLPurifier_HTMLModule_Ruby
classes.description: Represents the XHTML Ruby Annotation Module, defining elements and their relationships used for ruby annotations in HTML purification.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Configures the ruby annotation elements for the purifier by adding elements like 'ruby', 'rbc', 'rtc', 'rb', 'rt', and 'rp'.
